notes.title: Bug Fixes and Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
Hi guys! We had some reported bugs already corrected and more fixes are on the way. Also, the Leaderboard has been reset! Some bugs altered the game balance significantly and therefore the scores were not correctly reflected on the Leaderboard. That issue should be fixed now. Thanks for you patience and feedback! You guys are awesome.

Bug Fixes include: 
-  After a period of time, usually around 50k score, enemies would gradually stop spawning;
- Mechs would allow exploitation of points when dying;
- Some issues were causing severe FPS drops. That should mostly be corrected now.

We read every comment and we take all your feedback into account. 
Thanks for playing and believing in us ːsteamhappyː

Cheers!
